title: Settings save writes a predictable .tmp sibling without O_EXCL — a pre-placed symlink is followed
detail: os.write_entire_file opens O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_TRUNC with no O_EXCL (core/os/file_util.odin:254-256), so a pre-placed ~/.pp-settings.bin.tmp symlink redirects the 7-byte write. Realistically negligible: single-user desktop, 0700 HOME.
recommended_fix: Open the tmp file with O_CREATE|O_EXCL (skip the save on collision) or a unique temp name, then rename as today.
